intro: Five pieces of keropok lekor have an estimated 250 kcal. Most of the calories come from sago flour and frying oil, not the fish.
diet: Yes. Keropok lekor has a bit of protein from the fish, better than many other fried snacks. But 5 pieces is enough, because a full pack can easily hit 500 kcal. If there's a boiled option, that's lighter.
tips: Pick boiled or grilled keropok lekor if available.
Take 5 pieces and share the rest.
Go easy on the chilli sauce and skip thick sweet sauces.

swap.name: Boiled keropok lekor, 5 pieces
swap.why: Same fishy taste without frying oil, saving about 70 kcal.

faq.q: What fish is keropok lekor made from?
faq.a: Usually ikan tamban, ikan parang or ikan selayang, mixed with sago flour and salt.

faq.q: Where does keropok lekor come from?
faq.a: It's most famous from Terengganu, especially coastal areas like Kuala Terengganu and Losong.

faq.q: How do I fry frozen keropok lekor?
faq.a: Boil briefly or thaw first, then slice diagonally and fry in medium-hot oil.
